_comment: Tier-2 for sparta particle_emission: what 'fix emit/face' and 'fix emit/surf' reject, and the one override they accept in silence. Seven decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial). A 'fix in emit/face gas xlo' on a box declared 'boundary p o p' aborts before any stats line with 'ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face on periodic boundary (../fix_emit_face.cpp:182)'; the same fix on 'boundary o o p' runs to completion rc=0. Adding 'n 50' alone aborts with 'ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face n > 0 with perspecies yes (../fix_emit_face.cpp:100)', but adding 'perspecies no' makes it silent — rc=0, no error, no warning — and the steady particle count then tracks n, not nrho: the n=200 deck plateaus at 4.0x the n=50 deck. 'fix emit/surf gas nosuchgroup' aborts with 'ERROR: Fix emit/surf group ID does not exist (../fix_emit_surf.cpp:61)' and the same fix on a real 'group c surf id <= 50' runs. All three quoted strings were reproduced verbatim in this run; the only quantitative assertion is the RATIO between two decks of this same script, and it is bracketed 3-5, not pinned. COVERS: particle_emission:0, :4, :5 and hypersonic_flow:0 (the hypersonic row states the periodic-face restriction as its own claim string, and this script's deliberate placement of the fix at the end of the deck is what verifies its extra assertion that the check fires when the fix is DEFINED, not at run time).
expect_in_output: emit_face_on_a_periodic_face_message=ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face on periodic boundary (../fix_emit_face.cpp:182)
emit_face_n_with_default_perspecies_message=ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face n > 0 with perspecies yes (../fix_emit_face.cpp:100)
emit_surf_group_name_does_not_exist_message=ERROR: Fix emit/surf group ID does not exist (../fix_emit_surf.cpp:61)
